scope: Read-only static analysis and existing completed host-run receipt/log readback; no new guest execution, asset payload inspection, key use or runtime source edits.

current_stage.classification: Late IL2CPP runtime initialization, before creation of the GC finalizer thread.
current_stage.thread_name_evidence: Name assignment in thread entry identifies the GC finalizer.

get_info_static_contract.result_semantics: A nonzero Result aborts; success returns the low 32 bits of the out-u64 free-thread count.

metadata_control_flow.method: Build an instruction-address intraprocedural normal-control-flow graph from the authenticated AOT main image. Calls are treated as returning to the next instruction; direct branches are followed; RET terminates. No instruction bytes or disassembly dump is stored.
metadata_control_flow.success_test: main+0x55a0e4 tests bit 0 of the initializer return; zero branches to 0x55ac44 failure/return.
metadata_control_flow.inference_limit: This proves the successful metadata-loader/runtime-initializer control path was traversed in the observed run. It is not an independent per-file read log, metadata-content validation report, first-frame proof or proof that all later IL2CPP startup completed.

checked_metadata_loader_semantics.metadata_initialize: main+0x564190 calls 0x59cd10; its boolean result is retained (including spill/restore while x24 is reused) and returned at 0x5645b4.
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.load_and_consume: main+0x59cd34 calls 0x559b34; 0x59cd44 rejects NULL. The successful path reads metadata fields, including offsets 0xac, 0xb4, 0xa4 and 0x34, before returning true at 0x59ce90.
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.open: main+0x559bb8 calls the real-file Open abstraction; an open error selects the NULL return path.
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.mapping: main+0x559bf0 requests a whole-file read-only map via 0x5bcd24 -> 0x5bd0c0. The platform implementation has a real-file heap-copy path and a distinct internal registered-memory-mapping path. No separate actual-branch trace is present.
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.whole_file_size: In the real-file heap-copy path, 0x5b8a9c calls GetLength when requested size is zero; 0x5e0ed0 calls nn::fs::GetFileSize. The returned size controls allocation and the requested read.
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.read: 0x5b8ac8 calls File::Read at 0x5e1040; 0x5e106c calls nn::fs::ReadFile(out-count, handle, offset, buffer, size).
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.exact_count_gate: 0x5b8acc..0x5b8adc compares requested u64 to sign-extended returned i32 and checks the error code. A short read or error frees the copy and returns NULL. Original metadata size 16008508 is below INT32_MAX.
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.close: 0x559c00 closes the original file via 0x5e1a3c; a close error frees/unmaps the copy and selects NULL. A successful close preserves the separate copied metadata buffer.
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.host_binding: Compiled fs_host.c maps the exact imported OpenFile/GetFileSize/ReadFile/CloseFile symbols to real RomFS handle/index/image operations. Compiled romfs.c reads the verified image bytes and returns the completed byte count.
checked_metadata_loader_semantics.additional_direct_trace_if_required: For explicit I/O evidence, record only the exact allowlisted metadata path plus successful open/size, read offset/requested/completed/result and close result. Existing CASTLEVANIA_FS_LOG records opens; CASTLEVANIA_FS_TIMING is aggregate and cannot alone bind byte count to this file. No payload bytes or buffer dumps are needed.
